doc: Pairs this task did NOT measure, kept separate from the ones it did so the table never reads as if one session produced all of it. Each row names who took each side and where the number is written down. A row here is weaker evidence than a self-measured pair by exactly one session's worth of reproducibility, which this campaign puts at 4.60 % on this cell.
